def test_full_10_phase_loop(self):
        """完整10阶段闭环流转：waiting -> finished（全程同步快照）"""
        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room(3)
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

        # 开局
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.start_game(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("generate_script")
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("read_script")

        # 读本结束 -> 公聊
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("public_discuss")

        # 公聊结束 -> 证据派发
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("get_evidence")

        # 证据结束 -> 辩论
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("analyze_clue")

        # 辩论结束 -> 投票
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("final_vote")

        # 投票结束 -> 等待解锁
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("wait_unlock_review")

        # 解锁复盘
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.unlock_review(room_id, verify=True))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("ai_review")

        # 结束对局
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("finished")

        # 重启回归初始状态
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.restart_game(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("waiting")
